    <title>잉글리시아이 학원관리 v4</title>
    <style>
    :root{
    --navy:#0b2c5c;--navy2:#1e40af;--mint:#00b894;--mint2:#00d2a8;
    --gold:#f59e0b;--red:#ef4444;--blue:#3b82f6;--purple:#8b5cf6;
    --bg:#f0f4f8;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#f8fafc;--surface3:#f1f5f9;
    --border:#e2e8f0;--border2:#cbd5e1;
    --txt:#1e293b;--txt2:#475569;--txt3:#94a3b8;
    --sidebar-w:190px;--r:8px;--r-lg:12px;--r-xl:20px;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
    body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--txt);background:var(--bg);display:flex;height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}
    button{cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;border:none;outline:none}
    input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:13px;color:var(--txt);outline:none}
    #sidebar{width:var(--sidebar-w);background:var(--navy);display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex-shrink:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-anchor:none;z-index:200;transition:transform .25s}
    #sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px}
    #sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:2px}
    .sb-logo{padding:18px 16px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .sb-logo span{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;letter-spacing:-0.5px}
    .sb-logo span em{color:var(--mint);font-style:normal}
    .sb-sec{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding:14px 16px 5px;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase}
    .sb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;margin:1px 6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;transition:all .15s}
    .sb-item svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.7}
    .sb-sub{padding-left:32px!important;font-size:11px!important;border-left:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);margin-left:16px!important}
    .sb-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff}
    .sb-item.active{background:var(--mint);color:#fff}
    .sb-item.active svg{opacity:1}
    .sb-sub{font-size:11px;padding:8px 14px 8px 34px}
    #hdr-user{padding:12px 14px;margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
    #hdr-user strong{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:12px}
    #content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-anchor:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
    .view{display:none;flex-direction:column;height:100%}
    .view.active{display:flex}
    .page-top{padding:16px 20px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface)}
    .page-top h2{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy)}
    .page-top p{font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3);margin-top:2px}
    .toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 16px;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);flex-wrap:wrap}
    .cp{padding:14px 16px;flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
    .sec{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--txt3);letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px 0 6px}
    .card{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);border:1px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:12px}
    .expense-section{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-lg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
    .expense-section h4{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:10px}
    .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r);font-weight:600;transition:all .15s;font-size:12px;line-height:1}
    .btn-green{background:var(--mint);color:#fff}.btn-green:hover{background:var(--mint2)}
    .btn-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff}.btn-red:hover{opacity:.85}
    .btn-outline{background:var(--surface);border:1.5px solid var(--border2);color:var(--txt2)}.btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--navy);color:var(--navy)}
    .btn-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
    .btn-sm{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px}
    .btn-xs{padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px}
    .btn-block{width:100%;justify-content:center}
    .btn-kakao{background:#fee500;color:#3c1e1e;font-weight:700}.btn-kakao:hover{background:#f0d800}
    .fi{width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--surface);color:var(--txt);transition:border .15s;font-size:13px}
    .fi:focus{border-color:var(--navy)}
    .field{margin-bottom:10px}
    .fl{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--txt3);margin-bottom:4px}
    .r2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
    .tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
    .tbl th,.tbl td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px;text-align:left;white-space:nowrap}
    .tbl th{background:var(--surface2);font-weight:700;color:var(--txt2);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2}
    .tbl tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
    .rev-tbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
    .rev-tbl th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:8px 10px;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center}
    .blogplan-tbl{table-layout:fixed;border-collapse:collapse}
    .blogplan-wrap{overflow:visible}
    .rev-tbl td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap;text-align:center}
    .rev-tbl tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
    .tw{overflow-x:auto}
    .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
    .bg-navy{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}.bg-blue{background:#dbeafe;color:#1d4ed8}
    .bg-green{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.bg-red{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
    .bg-gold{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}.bg-gray{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--txt2)}
    .bg-mint{background:#ccfbf1;color:#0f766e}
    .mo{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:1000;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
    @media(min-width:600px){.mo{align-items:center}}
    .ms{background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--r-xl) var(--r-xl) 0 0;width:100%;max-height:94dvh;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 18px 26px;animation:slideUp .22s ease}
    @media(min-width:600px){.ms{border-radius:var(--r-xl);max-width:540px;max-height:88vh}}
    @keyframes slideUp{from{transform:translateY(40px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
    @keyframes bulbBlink{0%,100%{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px gold)}50%{opacity:0.2;filter:none}}
    .notes-bulb{display:inline-block;animation:bulbBlink 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;position:absolute;top:-10px;left:100%;font-size:13px;transform:rotate(45deg);transform-origin:bottom left;line-height:1;pointer-events:none;}
    .mh{width:36px;height:4px;background:var(--border2);border-radius:2px;margin:12px auto 16px}
    .mt{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:14px;text-align:center}
    #toast{position:fixed;bottom:80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(15,23,42,.92);color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;white-space:nowrap;max-width:90vw}
    #toast.show{opacity:1}
    #loading{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9998}
    .spinner{width:32px;height:32px;border:3px solid var(--border);border-top-color:var(--mint);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    #setup-screen,#login-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--navy) 0%,#0f1a35 100%);z-index:9997;display:flex;overflow-y:auto;padding:32px 20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
    .setup-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:20px;padding:28px;width:100%;max-width:400px;color:#fff}
    .setup-card h1{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
    .setup-card p{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-bottom:20px}
    .setup-fi{width:100%;padding:9px 12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:8px;color:#fff;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
    .setup-fi::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
    .period-box{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-lg);margin-bottom:12px;overflow:hidden}
    .period-header{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
    .student-cards{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:12px}
    .s-card{background:var(--surface2);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;width:calc(25% - 6px);flex:0 0 calc(25% - 6px);transition:all .15s;box-sizing:border-box}
    .s-card:hover{border-color:var(--mint);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,184,148,.15)}
    .s-card.done{border-color:var(--mint);background:#f0fdf4}
    .s-card.absent{border-color:var(--red);background:#fff8f8}
    .s-card.early{border-color:var(--gold);background:#fffbeb}
    .s-card.newstu{border-color:#fbbf24;background:#fef9c3}
    .s-card.observed{border-color:#fbbf24!important;background:#fef9c3!important}
    .s-card-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:3px}
    .s-card-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--txt3);margin-bottom:8px}
    .s-card-btns{display:flex;gap:5px}
    .att-btn{flex:1;padding:3px 2px;border-radius:5px;font-size:15px;border:none;background:transparent;transition:all .12s;line-height:1}
    .att-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.15);background:var(--surface2)}
    .att-btn.done-btn{color:#86efac}.att-btn.done-btn.active{background:#dcfce7;color:#16a34a}
    .att-btn.abs-btn{color:#fca5a5}.att-btn.abs-btn.active{background:#fee2e2;color:#dc2626}
    .att-btn.early-btn{color:#fcd34d}.att-btn.early-btn.active{background:#fef3c7;color:#d97706}
    .hist-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px}
    .hist-table th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:8px 10px;text-align:center;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;white-space:nowrap}
    .hist-table td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);vertical-align:middle;text-align:center}
    .hist-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--surface2);cursor:pointer}
    .absent-row td{background:#fff8f8 !important}
    .star-cell{font-size:14px;text-align:center}
    });
    var nums=periods.filter(function(p){return p.period>0;}).map(function(p){return p.period;});
    var hasDup=nums.some(function(n,i){return nums.indexOf(n)!==i;});
    if(hasDup){toast('⚠️ 교시 번호가 중복됩니다. 확인해 주세요.');return;}
    loading(true);
    await db.collection('config').doc('periods').set({periods:periods,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});
    customPeriods=periods;
    loading(false);
    toast('✅ 교시 설정 저장됨');
    renderPeriodSettings(); // 정렬된 상태로 화면 갱신
    }
    function addPeriodRow(){
    // 현재 화면에서 데이터 수집 후 새 항목 추가
    var current=_collectPeriodRows();
    var numericPeriods=current.filter(function(p){return p.period>0;});
    var nextNum=(numericPeriods.length?Math.max.apply(null,numericPeriods.map(function(p){return p.period;}))+1:1);
    if(nextNum>9)nextNum=1;
    current.push({period:nextNum,time:'',endTime:''});
    customPeriods=current;
    renderPeriodSettings();
    }
    function deletePeriodRow(idx){
    var current=_collectPeriodRows();
    current.splice(idx,1);
    // 숫자 교시만 재번호 (특강<0은 그대로 유지)
    var numIdx=0;
    current.forEach(function(p){
    if(p.period>0){p.period=++numIdx;}
    });
    customPeriods=current;
    renderPeriodSettings();
    }
    function _initApp(){
    bootProgress(5, 'Firebase 확인 중...');
    var cfg=getCfg();
    // Year/month selects
    var yr=new Date().getFullYear(),mo=new Date().getMonth()+1;
    ['rev-year','goals-year'].forEach(function(id){var el=$(id);if(!el)return;for(var y=yr-1;y<=yr+1;y++)el.innerHTML+='<option value="'+y+'"'+(y===yr?' selected':'')+'>'+y+'년</option>';});
    ['rev-month','goals-month'].forEach(function(id){var el=$(id);if(!el)return;for(var m=1;m<=12;m++)el.innerHTML+='<option value="'+m+'"'+(m===mo?' selected':'')+'>'+m+'월</option>';});
    var moSel=$('rev-month');if(moSel)moSel.style.display='none';
    var goMoSel=$('goals-month');if(goMoSel)goMoSel.style.display='none';
    if(!cfg){
    $('setup-screen').style.display='flex';
    hideBootOverlay();
    return;
    }
    initFb(cfg);
    }
    // Wait for Firebase SDK (defer scripts), then init
    if(document.readyState==='loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
    // Firebase SDK may not be ready yet due to defer
    var checkFb=function(){
    if(typeof firebase!=='undefined'){_initApp();}
    else{setTimeout(checkFb,50);}
    };
    checkFb();
    });
    } else {
    var checkFb2=function(){
    if(typeof firebase!=='undefined'){_initApp();}
    else{setTimeout(checkFb2,50);}
    };
    checkFb2();
    }
    </script>
